snippet.title: Babysitting Is Murder FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Babysitting Is Murder By FlamingTeddy Obligation Fulfilled End Horror Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

It's your average Friday night in October, with Sharol enjoying her evening reading scary stories while enjoying junk food. But hark, Mrs. Calamine calls and needs you to keep an eye on little Suzie, as Granny is having a medical emergency. Given the situation, Sharol readily agrees to the emergency job.

Babysitting Is Murder: https://flamingteddy.itch.io/babysitting-is-murder
Developer: FlamingTeddy
Genres: Horror
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
